requirements.description: Maintain 90% or higher test coverage across all modules
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Vitest coverage report shows >=90% line coverage for all src/ modules

requirements.description: TypeScript strict mode enabled with zero type errors
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: tsc --noEmit returns zero errors with all strict flags enabled

requirements.description: Zero lint errors (ESLint reports no errors on any file)
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: ESLint reports fewer than 1 error per 10,000 lines of code

requirements.description: Zero known security vulnerabilities in dependencies
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: npm audit reports 0 high or critical vulnerabilities

requirements.description: Use content-addressable SHA-256 hashes (16 chars) for all entity references
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: All requirements, gates, and proposals use deterministic 16-char hex hash identifiers

requirements.description: Lightweight SQLite schema with no server dependency
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: better-sqlite3 database operates without external server process

requirements.description: Database presence equals approval for requirements
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: No status column in requirements table; presence implies approved state

requirements.description: Generate iterative gates through decomposition of project end state
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: zeno init generates gate sequence from end state description

requirements.description: Provide CLI interface for all Zeno operations via Commander.js
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: All operations accessible via zeno <category> <action> command pattern

requirements.description: Expose all operations as MCP tools for LLM invocation
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: MCP server registers tools for gates, requirements, proposals, and analysis

requirements.description: Support hierarchical requirement decomposition with parent-child relationships
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Requirements table supports parent_id foreign key; children queryable by parent

requirements.description: Track dependencies between requirements using content-addressed hashes
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Dependency graph built from parent-child and cross-gate references

requirements.description: Support requirement transfer between gates during rescope
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: transferRequirement updates gate_id, source, source_gate_id for requirement and descendants

requirements.description: Generate AGENTS.md files for AI context and tool usage guidance
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: AGENTS.md generated during zeno init with project-specific instructions
